Callout.Name: Stolen Commercial Vehicle
Callout.Message: Flatbed truck taken from a yard.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle loaded with plant equipment, heading out of the city.

Script.Line: It went off the yard at about four this morning.
There is a tracked digger on the back of it. That is the part that worries me.
The keys were in the office. They are always in the office.

Lines.Approach: They took the truck with the equipment still on the back. They will be heading out of town.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
